MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN '2026/10/14' ELSE p.death_date END AS end_date
WITH p.position AS position,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) -
     CASE
       WHEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)

             AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) < CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, ',')
       THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %-d, %Y')
       ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') END AS birth,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN STRPTIME('2026/10/14', '%Y/%m/%d')
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.death_date, ',')
       THEN STRPTIME(p.death_date, '%B %-d, %Y')
       ELSE STRPTIME(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d') END AS ending
WITH p.position AS position,
  DATE_PART('year', ending) - DATE_PART('year', birth) -
  CASE WHEN DATE_PART('month', ending) < DATE_PART('month', birth)
         OR (DATE_PART('month', ending) = DATE_PART('month', birth)
             AND DATE_PART('day', ending) < DATE_PART('day', birth))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN position AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2
